The relay door is the class `signed` by TLS with the server certificate of the role `domainagent` (N1.6).
`relay` — a relay is admitted as any member (P/08.3), with its own key and its own report.
`door` — the variable `RELAY` is absent or empty — there is no door.
`door` — `RELAY` has another value — the agent does not start, exit code 2 — a refusal of the setting, P/02.4 N1.1\ncommon.
`door` — the relay's agent opens the door with `RELAY_HOST` (default 0.0.0.0) and `RELAY_PORT` (default 8446).
`door` — a member behind a relay uses the addresses of `RELAY_URL` in order: a connection refusal or 503 standby — the next one.
`door` — a member behind a relay gets `RELAY_MEMBER` — one, the name of the relay member.
`not_author` — the secret part of the holder's answer (the envelope `m1`, P/08.3 N1.5) the relay cannot open.
`one_hop` — the holder is nobody's relay.
`knocks` — the holder checks the signature of a knock by the key that the body presented (chapter 9.1 N1.2 key), over\n`POST /api/member/<name>` and the body.
`knocks` — a knock with an invalid signature or of a member, except an entry without key with revoked_keys (P/08.3 N3 «admit a member» step 1), is a skip.
`collecting` — while the relay keeps the word `collecting`, the relay door answers a stranger with a valid signature 403 with `send_row: true`.
`collecting` — while the relay keeps the word `collecting`, a body with `row` goes as a knock.
`relayed` of the answer — `rev` is for the road of this relay.
`refused` — `{reason: send_row}` — the gathering goes on, and the member is not in the list or has another key.
`refused` — on `{reason: send_row}` the relay door answers the member 403 with `send_row: true`.
`refused` — knocks are not here, in `refused`.
`keys` — a revoked key of a member of `relay_for` is an empty string.
`hold` — the answer of the batch did not make it within a pass plus FORWARD_WAIT — an answer from memory to the POST of the accepted member.

`hold` — the answer of the batch did not make it and there is no answer to this member in memory — 503 «`the relay has nothing from the domain for <member> yet`»: N2, N3 — the second case of this text, an accepted member with a new body before its first answer.
`rows` — the row of the holder's answer to `GET /api/members/<member>/<part>` is signed and is put into memory.
`rows` — the holder did not answer `GET /api/members/<member>/<part>` — the row from memory.
`rows` — the holder did not answer and there is no row in memory — the same 503 as in `hold`.
`domain_age` — a new carry for another member or an empty batch does not reset the `domain_age` of a cached carry.
Every response of a cached carry computes `domain_age` from the origin of that cached carry, including GET and the POST hold fallback.
A successful empty batch, a carry for another member, retries and `heard` do not refresh the origin of a cached carry.
A new carry of the same member replaces both the content and the origin of its cached carry, even if its content compares equal; it is a genuinely new confirmed holder response.
An old cache cannot renew expired grants.
The holder on the batch is [P/08.3](../../08-domain/spec/08.3-domain.norms.md) N3 «the holder on `POST /api/relay/<relay>`».
The client of a member behind a relay expects from the relay door the server role `domainagent` (the role certificate contract `peer_role`).
The relay door does not request a client certificate (the role\ncertificate contract `unasked`).
The relay door does not request a client certificate.
At the relay door the identity is the member's signature.
`BackupPartRevision` remains a required query `rev` on GET `/api/backup-part/{member}/{part}` as at the owner; no revision or default is inferred.
In the body of a refusal of the relay door normative are the status and `reason`.
